intro_cards.title: About these notes
body: 8 units · tectonics to contours

Grade 12 is “geography of Eritrea in depth”. Grade 11 is the toolkit: how the crust moves, how water and wind carve, how people settle, then a first look at Eritrea’s place, relief and contour maps. Read each unit as a *story with a cause* — examiners mark the cause, not only the landform name.

intro_cards.title: Worked contour gradient
body: Two points: 1 200 m and 1 000 m. Map distance between them is 4 cm. Scale 1:50 000 (1 cm = 500 m).
Rise = 200 m. Run = 4 × 500 = 2 000 m. Gradient = 200/2000 = 1 in 10 (or 10%). Write both the fraction and a sentence: “For every 10 m walked horizontally you climb 1 m.”

units.title: Geographic Position, Shape and Size of Eritrea
units.intro: Geographic Position, Shape and Size of Eritrea Deepen Geographic Position, Shape and Size of Eritrea with definitions, worked examples, and exam tips in the cards below.

cards.title: 6.1 Location
body: The relative location of Eritrea with respect to its neighboring, countries, water bodies and land masses.
The location of Eritrea can be expressed both in terms of the absolute and relative locations.

cards.title: Location of Eritrea
body: Eritrea is in the **Horn of Africa**, in the Northern and Eastern hemispheres, roughly between latitudes 12°N and 18°N and longitudes 36°E and 43°E. It borders **Sudan** to the wes

cards.title: Geographic position of Eritrea
body: Horn of Africa; Red Sea coast; neighbours Sudan, Ethiopia, Djibouti.
Shape/size affect climate variety, ports, and border length.

cards.title: Lat-long practice
body: Latitude: N/S of equator. Longitude: E/W of prime meridian.
Absolute location pins a place precisely.

cards.title: 6.3 The Size and Shape of Eritrea
body: Eritrea has a total area of 124,330 square kilometers.
Eritrea also possesses over 360 islands, which have a total coastline of over 1258.4 kilometers.

questions.q: The largest island in Eritrea is:
why: The textbook: 'The largest island is called Dahlak Kebir (Table 6.2).' Nora (Norah), north of Dahlak Kebir, is the second largest.
questions.tip: Read all the options before you choose; cross out the ones that belong to a different idea.

questions.q: The total area of Eritrea is larger than that of:
why: The textbook: Eritrea is larger in size than many countries in the world such as Seychelles, Andorra … and Malta.
Egypt, Sudan, Algeria and Ethiopia are all much larger than Eritrea (about 124,000 km²).
